name: AECi — Retention prune skipped (metrics_daily gap)
message:
The daily 03:00 UTC §7.4 retention prune (AECI-584 / Phase 8.3 P3.2) refused to run: a UTC day inside its `page_views` cut window has no `metrics_daily` row, so the 00:15 snapshot (AECI-581 / §7.1) never captured it. Nothing was deleted — from EITHER table — which is the safe direction, and no data has been lost yet.

What it means: `metrics_daily` is the only thing that survives a `page_views` prune, and D1 Time Travel recovers just ~30 days, so pruning a day the snapshot missed would destroy that day's traffic permanently. The gate is doing its job; the underlying fault is in the snapshot pipeline, not here. Read the `source:retention-prune-cron` log `aeci.retention.skipped` — it carries `window_from`, `window_to`, `missing_count` and the first ten `missing_days` — then check the metrics-snapshot cron on /admin/system and backfill the gap with `pnpm --filter @aeci/api ops:backfill-metrics-daily`. The prune resumes on its own the next night once every day in the window is captured.

Non-paging: the failure mode is 'stopped deleting', not 'deleted too much'. But do not sit on it — the table grows while it holds, and a long gap means the snapshot cron has been broken for a while.

Note: this monitor deliberately does NOT use notify_no_data — `outcome:skipped` is absent on a healthy run, so no-data here would be a constant false alarm. Cron liveness is the companion monitor 'AECi — Retention prune not running'.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#retention-prune-skipped-failed-or-not-running
